description: Takes a B2B SaaS vendor's Jira, Confluence or Jira Service Management app onto the Atlassian Marketplace and keeps it there - Forge vs Connect, Free vs Paid via Atlassian for a connector to a paid SaaS, payment-model locks, pricing and revenue share, approval prerequisites, major versions needing review and admin consent, Connect-to-Forge migration, Enterprise Certified (successor to Cloud Fortified), bug-fix SLAs. Use whenever a vendor mentions listing on the Atlassian Marketplace, a Marketplace Forge or Connect app, a stalled ECOHELP review, or applying for Cloud Fortified. Do NOT use for listing copy or search rank (use samber/developer-platform-skills@integration-listing-optimization), for Forge code, internal-only apps, Bitbucket, Compass or Trello apps, or buyers vetting apps.
